requirement.description: The get_domain_separator function is not correctly implementing EIP-712 domain separator calculation. The implementation has issues with byte padding and hashing of domain parameters, causing test failures for EIP-712 domain separator computation.
requirement.contract: Implement correct EIP-712 domain separator calculation according to the EIP-712 specification. The function should: 1. Properly compute the domain type hash using keccak256 on the type definition string 2. Correctly hash each domain parameter (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract) using keccak256 3. Properly concatenate the hashed parameters in the correct order 4. Return the final keccak256 hash of the concatenated parameters
requirement.acceptance: test_get_domain_separator in tests/ctc/binary/test_eip712.py should pass for both test0 and test1

requirement.description: The sign_transaction function is not correctly signing transactions according to the expected test vectors. The function appears to delegate to binary.sign_transaction but doesn't seem to be handling transaction standardization properly for the test cases.
requirement.contract: The sign_transaction function should: 1. Properly standardize the transaction using standardize_transaction function 2. Correctly sign the standardized transaction using binary.sign_transaction 3. Return the expected signature tuple (v, r, s) that matches the test vectors exactly
requirement.acceptance: test_sign_transaction in tests/ctc/evm/test_transaction_utils/test_transaction_utils.py should pass for both test0 and test1

requirement.description: The code is missing the __future__ import annotations which is required for proper type hinting and forward references in the codebase.
requirement.contract: Add the missing __future__ import annotations to all source files to ensure consistent type hinting behavior throughout the codebase.

requirement.description: Some CLI subcommands are failing due to execution timeouts or exit codes, indicating issues with command execution or parsing in the CLI framework.
requirement.contract: Ensure all CLI subcommands defined in command_index can be executed successfully without timeouts or exit codes. Fix any command execution issues that cause the test_subcommand_examples to fail.
requirement.acceptance: test_subcommand_examples in tests/ctc/cli/test_cli_subcommands.py should pass for all examples

requirement.description: The transaction signing implementation has issues with proper serialization of unsigned transactions, particularly for EIP-1559 transactions and handling of field name variations.
requirement.contract: Fix the serialize_unsigned_transaction function to properly handle all transaction types (legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559) with correct field mappings and proper RLP encoding.
requirement.acceptance: test_sign_transaction in tests/ctc/evm/test_transaction_utils/test_transaction_utils.py should pass for both test0 and test1
